payload.recallText: A story of a minor league player, Joe, getting a letter that he's likely getting drafted to the major leagues by the Saint Louis Cardinals. Though I think the first mention says Nationals. He is chatting with and teasing his sister, discussing how it will make him more money and famous, how he is currently part of the Pittson team, his mother walks in and he breaks a jug of water on accident by miming his pitching action. After discussing how he and his family feels, he has another letter from a girl he likes and her brother that they're coming to town that day on the train.
